dialogues.en:
Turning off the alarm that went off as I expected, I open my
eyes.
dialogues.text:
Turning off the alarm that went off as I expected, I open my
eyes.

dialogues.en:
Maybe because I didn't sleep very well, I woke up a while
ago.
dialogues.text:
Maybe because I didn't sleep very well, I woke up a while
ago.

dialogues.jp:
予感通りに鳴った目覚ましの音を消して、閉じ
ていた｛まぶた／瞼｝を開ける。
dialogues.en:
Lying down with my eyes closed, I was just waiting for the
alarm to go off...
dialogues.text:
Lying down with my eyes closed, I was just waiting for the
alarm to go off...

dialogues.jp:
なんか、今日の眠りは浅かったのか、そこそこ
前から意識があった。

ただ、横になったまま目を｛つむ／瞑｝り、目覚ましが鳴
るのを待っていただけ……。
dialogues.en:
It was probably because Mako moved her face so close to my
face yesterday...
dialogues.text:
It was probably because Mako moved her face so close to my
face yesterday...

dialogues.jp: 原因は昨日の眞子の顔のどアップかな……。
dialogues.en: I don't feel like going back there...
dialogues.text: I don't feel like going back there...

dialogues.en: "No choice... I have to go."
dialogues.text: "No choice... I have to go."

dialogues.jp: ちょっと気恥ずかしい気もするが……。
dialogues.en:
Just like yesterday, I put my arms through my uniform
sleeves and leave the room.
dialogues.text:
Just like yesterday, I put my arms through my uniform
sleeves and leave the room.

dialogues.en: Nemu is sitting at the table and eating a slice of toast.
dialogues.text: Nemu is sitting at the table and eating a slice of toast.

dialogues.jp:
昨日と同じように制服の袖に腕を通し、部屋を
出る。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What's the matter?"
dialogues.text: "What's the matter?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢がテーブルの席について、トーストを食べ
ている。
dialogues.en: "No, nothing."
dialogues.text: "No, nothing."

dialogues.en:
Getting a slice of square bread out of the bag, I put it in
the toaster.
dialogues.text:
Getting a slice of square bread out of the bag, I put it in
the toaster.

dialogues.jp:
たまにでいいから、ご飯に味噌汁、焼き魚と
いった朝食が食べたい。
dialogues.en: (8 slices......)
dialogues.text: (8 slices......)

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: I look at the bag casually and put the bread in the toaster.
dialogues.text: I look at the bag casually and put the bread in the toaster.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Niisan?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan?"

dialogues.jp: 袋から食パンを出し、トースターに入れる。
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "I heard a rumor...... About you and Mako."
dialogues.text: "I heard a rumor...... About you and Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Oh... Well, we're deliberately creating a buzz."
dialogues.text: "Oh... Well, we're deliberately creating a buzz."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんか、兄さんと眞子のこと……噂になって
　たよ」
dialogues.en:
We've done so much, so it would be strange if nobody talks
about us.
dialogues.text:
We've done so much, so it would be strange if nobody talks
about us.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ……ま、噂になるようにしてるからな」
dialogues.en: "But you guys are 'pretending', right?"
dialogues.text: "But you guys are 'pretending', right?"

dialogues.jp:
あそこまでして噂にならなかったら、むしろお
かしい。
dialogues.en: "Yep. Don't tell this to anyone, especially to Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Yep. Don't tell this to anyone, especially to Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: She can't keep a secret. I bet she put some oil on her lips.
dialogues.text: She can't keep a secret. I bet she put some oil on her lips.

dialogues.jp:
あいつは口の滑りがいいからな。油でも塗って
るんじゃないか？
dialogues.en: I guess I don't have to explain about Suginami.
dialogues.text: I guess I don't have to explain about Suginami.

dialogues.en: Ching----
dialogues.text: Ching----

dialogues.jp: トースターのタイマーが切れた音が響く。
dialogues.en: The timer of the toaster rings.
dialogues.text: The timer of the toaster rings.

dialogues.jp: 指先で軽く摘み、素早く皿に移す。
dialogues.en:
I hold the bread with my fingertips and quickly put it on
the plate.
dialogues.text:
I hold the bread with my fingertips and quickly put it on
the plate.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "You know what?... Yesterday..."
dialogues.text: "You know what?... Yesterday..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Mm? What?"
dialogues.text: "Mm? What?"

dialogues.jp:
トーストにマーガリンを塗りながら、声だけ音
夢に答える。
dialogues.en: I reply to her while spreading some margarine on the bread.
dialogues.text: I reply to her while spreading some margarine on the bread.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ううん……何でもない。たぶんただの噂のハ
　ズだから……」
dialogues.en: "No... Never mind. Because it must just be gossip..."
dialogues.text: "No... Never mind. Because it must just be gossip..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢に視線を向けると、少し大きめの最後の欠
片を、口に詰め込んでいるところだった。
dialogues.en:
I glance at Nemu, who's stuffing the last but a little
larger piece of bread into her mouth.
dialogues.text:
I glance at Nemu, who's stuffing the last but a little
larger piece of bread into her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "I hav'to go now."
dialogues.text: "I hav'to go now."

dialogues.jp: 口をもぐもぐさせながら、席を立ち背を向ける。
dialogues.en: Mumbling, Nemu gets up from her seat and turns her back.
dialogues.text: Mumbling, Nemu gets up from her seat and turns her back.

dialogues.jp:
「なんだ、もう少し待ってくれれば一緒に行け
　るのに」
dialogues.en: "If you wait just a little longer, we can leave together."
dialogues.text: "If you wait just a little longer, we can leave together."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん……でも、なるべく早く行って見回らな
　いといけないから」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah... But I have to be there as soon as I can, to go on
patrol."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah... But I have to be there as soon as I can, to go on
patrol."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあね、兄さん。行ってきます」
dialogues.en: "See you, niisan. Bye."
dialogues.text: "See you, niisan. Bye."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Take care."
dialogues.text: "Take care."

dialogues.en: Bang.
dialogues.text: Bang.

dialogues.jp: 扉の向こうに、音夢の笑顔が消える。
dialogues.en: Nemu's smile disappears the other side of the door.
dialogues.text: Nemu's smile disappears the other side of the door.

dialogues.en: Ting-a-ling...
dialogues.text: Ting-a-ling...

dialogues.jp: 微かに鈴の音をたてて、廊下を遠ざかっていく。
dialogues.en:
Her bell tinkles faintly as she disappears into the
distance.
dialogues.text:
Her bell tinkles faintly as she disappears into the
distance.

dialogues.en: "......Oh well."
dialogues.text: "......Oh well."

dialogues.jp:
静かになってしまった居間で、はぐり、とパン
にかじりつく。
dialogues.en: I bite into the bread, in the suddenly-quiet living room.
dialogues.text: I bite into the bread, in the suddenly-quiet living room.

dialogues.jp: 俺と眞子の噂が広まっていると音夢から聞いた。

苦労が報われ、喜ばしい限りなのだが、何かい
いたげな音夢の後姿がなんだか寂しそうだった。
dialogues.en: It should go off any time now...
dialogues.text: It should go off any time now...
